title: Zolochiv
summary: Zolochiv refers to multiple locations within [[ukraine|Ukraine]], primarily associated with [[lviv|Lviv]] and Kharkiv Oblasts. These include cities, raions, and hromadas that play a role in the administrative and cultural landscape of the country.

sections.heading: Zolochiv in Lviv Oblast
paragraphs: Zolochiv is a city located in [[lviv-oblast|Lviv Oblast]], which serves as a significant urban center in the region.
Zolochiv Raion is a subdivision named after the city, highlighting its administrative importance.
The Zolochiv urban hromada is situated within this raion, contributing to local governance and community organization.

sections.heading: Zolochiv in Kharkiv Oblast
paragraphs: In [[kharkiv-oblast|Kharkiv Oblast]], Zolochiv is designated as an urban-type settlement, reflecting its status and population density.
Zolochiv Raion in Kharkiv Oblast was a former subdivision, indicating historical administrative changes in the region.

sections.heading: Zolochivska Rural Hromada
paragraphs: Zolochivska rural hromada is located southeast of [[kyiv|Kyiv]], emphasizing the diverse administrative structures present [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]].
